note: Manually curated. Sources: CRED, GPay, PhonePe offer pages, bank apps, r/CreditCardsIndia. Update when platforms change their reward structures.

platforms.name: CRED
platforms.note: Earns CRED Coins; avg redemption ~₹0.25–₹0.50/coin. Occasional flat cashback offers for specific cards.

platforms.name: Google Pay
platforms.note: Occasional scratch cards; no guaranteed reward. 5% cashback on Axis Ace card for utility bill payments.

platforms.name: PhonePe
platforms.note: Rare cashback via PhonePe Rewards. Generally not competitive for bill payments.

platforms.name: Bank's own app
platforms.note: Direct payment via net banking or bank's app earns 0 additional reward on top of card points.

platforms.name: BHIM / UPI
platforms.note: Standard UPI bill pay — no reward unless your credit card has a UPI cashback offer.

recommendations.note: Best option — CRED often has Amazon HDFC-specific offers.
Direct via HDFC SmartPay — still earns 1% Amazon Pay cashback on the card.
SBI Cashback card earns 5% on online payments — paying via SBI YONO or net banking counts as online.
CRED bill payment counts as online — stacks card's 5% + CRED Coins.
GPay bill payment counts as online for SBI Cashback 5% category.
Axis Ace earns 5% on all utility bill payments via Google Pay — pay your own card's bill here if it qualifies as a utility. Works for electricity, broadband, etc.
Direct bill payment via CRED — earns base 1.5% on Ace.
CRED counts as an online/app payment — HDFC Millennia earns 5% CashPoints on selected online portals including CRED.

recommendations.return_label: 5% CashPoints via PayZapp / 1% base via GPay
recommendations.note: GPay = 1% base. Prefer CRED or PayZapp for 5%.
Bill payment earns standard base rate only. No accelerated category for bill pay.
Stacks base card points with CRED Coins.
